findings.title: Shape-only NPZ validation accepts unusable features and silently truncates fractional class labels.
findings.trigger: A local NPZ has X/Y with the required dimensions and matching row count, but X is a Unicode string array or Y contains nonintegral labels; complete valid local raw data exists.
findings.actual: Both datasource constructors accept the cache in load_cache. Nonnumeric X fails later in VectorDataset with TypeError, so the invalid-cache recovery branch never runs and the unusable cache persists. Y=[0.7,1.7,2.7] is accepted and silently cast by torch.tensor(dtype=long) to labels [0,1,2]; the fractional NPZ remains unchanged. The cache parser validates shape alone before bypassing correct available preprocessing.
findings.impact: A malformed cache can permanently block otherwise valid offline initialization or silently change labels. The new cache-validation/rebuild contract is incomplete even though atomic publication and flock are correct.

findings.title: Stale image roots with missing required samples still bypass download recovery.
findings.trigger: An actual successful localhost download has a .complete marker. Delete CINIC test/n001/z.png while preserving test/n001/, or delete Tiny val/images/z.png while preserving val/images/ and its annotation referencing z.png; source server remains available.
findings.actual: CINIC ready() remains true because train/ and test/ exist, so ImageFolder raises FileNotFoundError for a class with no images. Tiny _locate_layout returns native solely because the annotation file and images directory exist; construction reports a sample whose required image is absent, then actual __getitem__ raises FileNotFoundError. No recovery request occurs. HTTP hit count remains one and the stale marker remains. Same result with controlled default Tiny URL dispatch.
findings.impact: Previously completed datasets remain unusable after required extracted sample loss despite a working recovery source. The R2A-04 correction covers missing directories/annotations but does not establish a usable extracted dataset.
